//: A place to set out from when you choose to begin in the open country. It is only built when chosen as the starting point.

crossroads.name: the Wayfarers' Crossroads
crossroads.start_label: The Wilds - a traveller at a crossroads, with the whole land ahead

camp.name: Wayfarers' Camp
camp.description: A trampled clearing just off the road where travellers have camped for longer than anyone remembers. The ashes of last night's fire are still warm, and your pack lies where you slept.

crossroads.name: Wayfarers' Crossroads
crossroads.description: Four roads meet at a weathered signpost, each running off toward a horizon you have never seen. Whatever is out there, every road leads to it eventually.
